## Alooooha!

<hr class="custom-line">

I'm Zach, a data science lover passionate about the environment. Born and raised in Hawaii connected me to a culture that emphasizes environmental health and led me to this environmental journey I'm on. I have career interests in water quality, waste management, and renewable energy. On my free time, I enjoy surfing, reading, gaming, and cooking Japanese curry. Feel free to surf around my website to learn more!
